rv.q: Are You Even Indian, is a gorgeous mix of theatre and dance, exploring whether a British-born Indian woman and Indian-born man can solve clashes over what it means to be Indian.
Are You Even Indian? is a warmly watchable 60 minutes of theatre which raises issues at least two levels.
The show is engaging and funny!
Are You Even Indian? is a wonderfully perceptive and moving piece of theatre.
Using mixed media, dance and brilliant writing, Are You Even Indian? is not only a conversation starter but also part of the conversation it seeks to provoke.
The research and community interaction that went into the making of the play shines through in the final product.
Are You Even Indian? is an accomplished play, visually bold and entertaining, that tackles hefty issues sensitively, avoiding easy answers and arriving at a wisely open ending.
Are you even Indian? is a compelling story of cultural nuances, perceptions, aspirations, and expectations.

cn.t: Critics largely praise *Are You Even Indian?* for its witty, poignant exploration of South Asian identity, with Mathur's triple-threat performance and inventive dance sequences earning particular acclaim. A few find it uneven, but most call it a must-see.
